description: Structured plans only (not older free-text plans). Compare planned and actual filming time between consecutive ticks in field mode. plannedSeconds is the planned time of those measured tick-to-tick steps, not the whole plan; planPlannedSeconds is the whole plan's planned shot work when present. Read-only. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderReference also works. Connections see only their own live or owner-test plans.
name: shoot_plan_timing
title: Compare planned and actual time
